headline: NYE RESERVATIONS ARE OPEN.

feed.alt_text: NYE reservations are open at Twisted Pin for December 31, 2026. Six party start times: 11am, 1pm, 3pm, 5pm, 7:30pm and 10pm. Each reservation covers its chosen party. A real Twisted Pin bowling-party photograph. Reserve at www.twistedpin.com/new-years-eve/.
